releaseNotes: Custom icons fixed for real — clones now get genuine adaptive icons: your photo keeps full quality (no more black or blurry icons), and every icon variant of the app is replaced, including Discord's in-app icon styles (matte dark and friends)
Icon editor redesigned: cleaner full-screen editor with live launcher previews (circle / squircle / rounded) so you see exactly what your home screen will show
Fixed 'Download failed' when installing Pic Hider from the Products tab
Downloaded APKs (app updates and studio products) are cleaned up automatically after install — your storage no longer fills up
Pre-installed apps updated from the Play Store (YouTube, Amazon, PhonePe…) can now be cloned like any normal app
New researched sections in About: why some apps show 'Get the app from Google Play' and how to handle Google sign-in / passkeys in clones
Pic Hider v1.1.0 in the Products tab: app disguise — switch its launcher name and icon (Calculator, Notes, Gallery, or your own custom shortcut)
